author: Hola
body:
I remember seeing a thread like this a few months back and as I'm running out of music it would be cool if some people would mind to share their playlists. 
I guess as the OP I need to start this off so here's mine https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLI5H9lBfoHLOFj4qpHc6HXZdXTPPMaJtn 
My music taste changes quite often so there's quite a few genres in it.

replies.author: FrostedCupcakez
replies.body: Ahhh, Jaymes Young is amazing. Have you heard Moondust (Stripped) by him? Prob my favourite :') Paralyzed by Mystery Skulls, Kayne by The Chainsmokers, Beam & Our Story by Mako, Overtime by Cash Cash, and Up All Night by Arty and Angel Taylor are great songs songs too! I suggest them ;P
